title: From Extraction to Governed Memory: Multi-Agent Knowledge Graph Construction with Domain-Expert Review
abstract: arXiv:2608.28642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge graphs used by agentic systems are often treated as flat stores of extracted triples, with little record of who owns a fact, why it was admitted, or how it should be used downstream. We argue that reliable agentic knowledge systems require governance as an essential component of graph construction to bridge this gap. We propose MAGG, a principled multi-agent framework for constructing Governed Knowledge Graphs that introduces explicit governance decisions for reliable and trustworthy knowledge sharing. A domain classifier first induces entity and relation types directly from document content, enabling operation in open-world settings without fixed schemas. Candidate triples are assigned to domain owners, reviewed against supporting evidence, admitted through governance decisions, and stored with audit metadata. The same ownership structure is reused during question answering, where queries are routed to domain-specific graph ex

translated_title: 从抽取到受治理的记忆：基于领域专家评审的多智能体知识图谱构建
translated_abstract: 智能体系统所使用的知识图谱通常被视为抽取三元组的扁平存储库，很少记录事实的归属者、其被纳入的原因，或其在下游应如何使用。我们认为，要弥合这一差距，可靠的智能体知识系统需要将治理作为图谱构建的核心组成部分。我们提出了MAGG，一个用于构建受治理知识图谱的原则性多智能体框架，通过引入显式的治理决策来实现可靠且可信的知识共享。领域分类器首先直接从文档内容中归纳实体和关系类型，使其能够在没有固定模式的开放世界环境中运行。候选三元组被分配给领域所有者，根据支持证据进行评审，通过治理决策被接纳，并附带审计元数据存储。相同的所有权结构在问答过程中被复用，查询被路由到特定领域的图专家进行处理。
tldr: 提出MAGG多智能体框架，通过领域分类器自动归纳模式、领域所有者评审证据并做出显式治理决策，将知识图谱从扁平的三元组存储升级为带所有权和审计元数据的可治理记忆。
en_tdlr: Proposes MAGG, a multi-agent framework that transforms knowledge graphs from flat triple stores into governed memory by automatically inducing schemas from documents and assigning domain owners to review evidence and make explicit governance decisions with audit metadata.
